ABS Non-Conformity : Requirements: 
STCW Section A-VIII/1 notes that all persons who shall be provided with a rest period of not less than a minimum of 10 hours of rest in any 24-hour period, the hours of rest may be divided into no more than two periods, one of which shall be at least 6 hours in length.
Evidence: 
There was no a rest period that is at least 6 hours for below crew and time interval listed.
1. C/O, 1600 hr. / 28-Feb-2026 to 1600 hr. / 01-Mar-2026
2. 3/O, 1600 hr. / 28-Feb-2026 to 1600 hr. / 01-Mar-2026
3. 4/E (Mr. Wei), 2000 hr. / 28-Feb-2026 to 2000 hr. / 01-Mar-2026
4. AB (Mr. Xia), 1600 hr. / 28-Feb-2026 to 1600 hr. / 01-Mar-2026
5. MM (Mr. Gerarman), 1600 hr. / 28-Feb-2026 to 1600 hr. / 01-Mar-2026
Nature: 
The above-listed crew’s resting hours records were considered against STCW and MLC requirements.

ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement: 
As per the Safety and Environmental Management Manual Rev. 22, PR-1001, Section 5.2 "Report and treatment of deficiencies" & Section 5.5 "Routing maintenance", the ship is to be properly maintained and operated so that it remains in conformance with all applicable international standard and requirements.
Evidence: 
During the walkabout inspection during the audit, the M/E crankcase between Cyl. #4 and Cyl. #5 was leaking oil, and an unauthorized drain arrangement was modified.
Nature of NC: 
The ship was not properly maintained and operated in compliance with the requirements.
Class - Prop. Shaft Survey once every 15 years
